home.layout: Orange top nav bar, then a single-column numbered list of 30 stories with rank, upvote triangle, title, domain in parens, and a subtext line with points/author/time/comments, ending with a 'More' link.

new.layout: Identical layout to home but stories sorted by submission time; numbered list with rank, vote arrow, title, and subtext metadata line.

ask.layout: Numbered list of text-only Ask HN questions with no domain in parens, each followed by points/author/time/comments subtext.

show.layout: Numbered list of Show HN posts with title prefix 'Show HN:', optional domain, and standard subtext line beneath each.

jobs.layout: Numbered list of YC job postings showing role and company as the title with domain in parens and a posted-time subtext, no voting arrows.
